help.text:
fwb - Flutter WSL Bridge

Exposes a Windows desktop Flutter app as a Flutter custom device so that
`flutter run -d fwb` inside WSL drives a native Windows window with hot reload.

Usage:
  fwb config set <key> <value>     set a setting (like `go env -w`)
  fwb config get <key>            print a setting
  fwb config unset <key>          remove a setting
  fwb config list                 list effective settings and their source

  fwb install-device              register/update the custom device
  fwb uninstall-device            remove the custom device
  fwb doctor                      diagnose the environment
  fwb clean [--sdk]               remove the project mirror (and the SDK cache)

  fwb ping / install / uninstall / launch
                                  custom-device hooks called by flutter

Settings:
  windows.flutter       use an existing Windows Flutter SDK (default: download)
  windows.mirrorRoot    Windows-side mirror root (default %LOCALAPPDATA%\fwb)
  windows.pubCache      PUB_CACHE for the Windows SDK
  windows.storageBaseUrl  artifact mirror (default FLUTTER_STORAGE_BASE_URL)
  device.id             custom device id (default fwb)
  i18n.lang             UI language (en, zh-CN)
device.label: Windows desktop (via fwb)
launch.preparingBuild: preparing the Windows build (first run or native inputs changed)
err.config.emptyKey: the key must not be empty
err.win.noPowerShell: powershell.exe not found; is WSL interop enabled? check /etc/wsl.conf [interop] and `wsl --status`
err.project.notFlutter: %s is not a Flutter project (pubspec.yaml missing)
err.project.noWindows:
the project has no windows/ directory
run `flutter create --platforms=windows .` first, then retry
err.project.noBundle: asset bundle %s not found (did flutter finish building?)
err.project.stagedBundle: no staged WSL asset bundle; did the install hook fail?
err.flutter.releaseIndex: cannot fetch the Windows release index %s
err.flutter.releaseNotFound: Flutter %s (channel %q) not found in the Windows release index; fwb needs the official portable SDK for the same version as WSL
err.flutter.overrideMismatch:
windows.flutter engine revision does not match WSL
  WSL:     %s (%s)
  Windows: %s (%s)
run `fwb config unset windows.flutter` to let fwb download the matching SDK
err.sdk.download: cannot download the Windows Flutter SDK: %s
err.sdk.overrideInvalid: %s is not a valid Flutter SDK (bin/flutter.bat missing)
